references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 s. 23
references.locator: Normal working time exceeds 8 hours a day or 48 a week (7 and 42 for hazardous work) (LPA s.23).

description: Normal working time must not exceed eight hours a day or forty-eight hours a week, or seven and forty-two hours for hazardous work (LPA s.23).

references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 s. 27
references.locator: A day of more than five consecutive working hours was recorded without a rest break (LPA s.27).

description: More than five continuous working hours need a rest break of at least one hour (LPA s.27).

references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 s. 44
references.locator: An employee under 15 may not be employed (LPA s.44).

description: A child under fifteen may not be employed (LPA s.44).

references.title: Wage Committee Notification on Minimum Wage Rates (No. 14), 17 June 2025, in force 1 July 2025
references.locator: Provincial daily minimum wage, 337 to 400 baht; a day is the normal working time, not more than 7 hours for hazardous work and 8 hours otherwise.

description: The contract's daily rate must meet the minimum wage of the contract worksite, or the nationwide hotel and service rate (Wage Committee Notification No.14).

references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 s. 90
references.locator: The contract pays a certified worker less than the skill-standard wage rate of the trade (LPA s.90 with the Wage Committee skill-standard notification).

description: A certified worker's day wage must reach the skill-standard rate recorded for the trade (LPA s.90).

references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 s. 27 para 1
references.locator: five or more working hours with no recorded rest break (LPA s.27).

description: Planned overtime longer than five continuous hours needs a recorded rest break (LPA s.27).

references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 ss. 17, 23, 118
references.locator: Select the employment type, work classification, statutory work category and residency status permitted by this jurisdiction version.

description: Work classification and tax-residency values must be among this jurisdiction's permitted categories.

references.title: Social Security Act B.E. 2533; Revenue Code; Royal Ordinance B.E. 2560
references.locator: The recorded personal details or agreement terms do not meet this jurisdiction version’s requirements.

description: A PVD member's contribution rate must be 2-15 percent and the overtime-exempt category must be one the law allows (Provident Fund Act s.10; LPA s.65).

references.title: Social Security Act B.E. 2533 s. 34; Workmen's Compensation Act B.E. 2537
references.locator: The recorded employer details do not meet this jurisdiction version’s requirements.

description: The employer's province must be recorded and its WCF business code must be five digits (SSA s.34; WCA).

references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 s. 76
references.locator: Record the actual ordered requested/agreed interval, beginning on or after receipt/conclusion; do not infer permanent standing from a request.

description: A deduction consent's ordered interval must start on or after receipt and end on or after it starts (LPA s.76).

references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 s. 76
references.locator: A signed request/consent needs its actual prior signature date and the signed source document.

description: A signed deduction consent needs its signature date on or before receipt and the signed document (LPA s.76).

references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 s. 76
references.locator: Attach the actual request/agreement/receipt/delivery evidence for this business event; an unrelated file does not establish its dates, amount or scope.

validate:
// Attach the original source document supporting the case's exact dates, amount and scope.
return get(ctx.entry, 'evidence_file', null) != null;
description: A deduction consent or security deposit needs its supporting document (LPA s.76).

references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 s. 76
references.locator: A deduction consent lists each authorised deduction code once with its actual amount limit and currency.

description: A deduction consent must list each authorised deduction code once (LPA s.76).
A work-injury leave entry needs at least one dated day so the 15-day notification runs from a real injury date (WCA s.48).

references.title: Workmen's Compensation Act B.E. 2537 as amended, s.48
references.locator: The employer notifies the SSO within 15 days of the day the employer knows of the injury; a slotless entry has no injury date.
